description.value: Body Energy Club is a Vancouver-born health food chain founded in 2002, offering sports supplements, vitamins, energy gels, electrolytes, protein bars, and a smoothie and cold-pressed juice bar. The Waterfront Station location is tucked inside one of Vancouver's busiest transit hubs at the edge of the seawall cycling network. Cyclists can stock up on ride nutrition — gels, electrolytes, and snacks — or grab a smoothie or healthy to-go meal before or after a ride.
